# Robin Farrow

## Overview

- **Age:** 10 years old  <sub>[v3 c28 P4](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0004)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c8 P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033)</sub>
- **Origin:** East Welby  <sub>[v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Student and aspiring farm worker  <sub>[v2 c22 P19](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0019), [v2 c22 P20](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0020), [v4 c4 P8](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0008)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Mr. Robin Farrow  <sub>[v2 c8 P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011)</sub>; Robin-boy  <sub>[v2 c24 P11](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0011), [v3 c28 P9](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0009)</sub>

## Appearance

Robin is a fair-haired, attractive boy with a round skull covered in tiny, fuzzy yellow ringlets. He has a snub nose, a perpetually smiling mouth, and a single dimple in one cheek that gives him a sweet, amusing, and uneven expression when he laughs. His face and eyes dance with an elfish, mischievous joy.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033), [v2 c20 P8](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0008), [v2 c20 P9](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0009)_

## Personality

Robin is naturally mischievous, lively, and energetic, possessing an intense desire for excitement and fun. Though prone to impish pranks, stubborn defiance, and occasional falsehoods to cover his misdeeds, he has an intensely affectionate heart and feels profound remorse when he realizes he has upset those he loves. He is endlessly curious and inquisitive about the world, frequently asking complex or awkward questions to the adults around him.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P30](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0030), [v2 c8 P53](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0053), [v2 c8 P54](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0054), [v2 c10 P43](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0043), [v2 c10 P52](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0052), [v2 c26 P30](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0030), [v3 c7 P30](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0030), [v3 c7 P34](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0034), [v3 c13 P101](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0101)_

## History

Following the death of his sick mother in East Welby, Robin and his twin sister Lucy were brought to Grey Shutters by Thirza Abernethy, their third cousin once removed. Initially, Robin proved to be an overwhelming handful, constantly indulging in wild pranks, lying to avoid trouble, and terrorizing the household by putting a toad in Thirza's bed and locking Lucy inside a building. Through the gentle guidance and affection of Nell, Robin's behavior gradually improved, although his mischievous nature frequently resurfaced. When his uncle Richard Farrow died, a trust fund was established under Thirza's care to support Robin and Lucy. As Robin grew older, he entered school, made friends like Milty Gammon, and developed a keen interest in agriculture, eventually seeking permission to help manage the farm.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c1 P35](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0035), [v2 c7 P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002), [v2 c8 P30](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0030), [v2 c8 P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060), [v2 c10 P36](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0036), [v2 c10 P37](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0037), [v2 c10 P52](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0052), [v2 c22 P20](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0020), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v4 c4 P7](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0007), [v4 c4 P8](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0008)_
